mentions.name: Lungy
mentions.description: Breathing app that uses a phone to recognise and measure breathing in real time, with breathing driving interactive visuals such as fluid, cloth and soft-body simulations.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's a breathing app that uses your phone to recognise and measure breathing in real-time. Breathing also drives interactive visuals, e.g. fluid, cloth sims and soft body sims.
mentions.author: lukko
